about: Senokot (senna, a stimulant laxative), by brand name only, is supplied six times from January to September 2026 to a 72-year-old woman.
Dulcolax (bisacodyl) 5 mg is supplied three times from January to March 2026 to a 74-year-old man, in the middle of a 14-month history, and each pack lasts 25 days at two tablets a night.

The regular laxative is Movicol (macrogol), which is not a stimulant laxative, and the only bisacodyl is one pack of three Lax-Tab tablets taken as a single dose before a colonoscopy, which is not more than 3 days.
